The vendor directly providing the software product **Intelli-CTi** at **intellicti.com** is **QWARE Limited**.

### Supporting Evidence:
* **Terms & Conditions and Policies:** On [intellicti.com/terms-conditions](https://www.intellicti.com/terms-conditions), the terms governing the service are published by **QWARE** (e.g., *QWARE Subscription Agreement*, *QWARE Master Services Agreement*, and *QWARE Acceptable Use Policy*), specifying: *"QWARE believes that sharing information about the way we operate and securing your data is the way to earn and maintain your trust"*.
* **Contact & Ownership Information:** The Contact and legal notices across the site state: *"© QWARE Limited. All Rights Reserved"* and provide contact details for *"QWARE Limited Headquarters UK & Rest of the World"*. Product collateral also identifies: *"intelli-CTi™ is a trademark of QWARE Limited"*.
